ei.title: Acting in Haste Comes at a High Cost

fullPassage: The desire to rush into something often shows a lack of clarity of vision and values. Impatience could be driven by fear, worry or greed, or be an attempt to relieve pain, a desire to look good in front of others, or a fear of missing out, and so on. Most people overestimate what they can achieve in a short time and underestimate what they can achieve in a lifetime. You have more time than you think. Impatience will lead to overpaying for assets and consumables, and you risk others taking advantage of you. There are great deals out there all the time. If you miss this one, there will be others that come along. They may even be better.

det.analysis:
❌ ① to relieve: an attempt to + 동사원형(~하려는 시도) — 적절.

❌ ④ that: 선행사 others를 받는 관계대명사 — 적절.

det.korean: that → what (overestimate의 목적어절에 선행사 포함 관계사 필요).
det.analysis:

✅ ② that: overestimate의 목적어절에서 achieve의 목적어가 없으므로 what이 필요. that은 접속사로 완전한 절을 이끄지만 여기서는 목적어가 빠진 불완전한 절.
❌ ③ taking: risk + V-ing — 적절.
❌ ④ along: come along(나타나다) 부사 — 적절.
det.tip: what = the thing that. achieve의 목적어가 필요한 불완전 절 → what.

✅ ② be patient and avoid rushing into decisions: 성급함의 부정적 결과를 경고하며 인내를 권하는 것이 핵심.

ch: Rushing into decisions is the best strategy for achieving success in competitive markets.
People who act slowly always miss the best opportunities in life.
Impatience, driven by fear and poor time perception, leads to overpaying and exploitation, so patience and long-term thinking are wiser.
Fear and greed are positive motivators that help people make better choices.

questions.passage: The desire to rush into something often shows a __________ of clarity of vision and values. Impatience could be driven by fear, worry or greed, or be an attempt to relieve pain, a desire to look good in front of others, or a fear of missing out, and so on. Most people overestimate what they can achieve in a short time and underestimate what they can achieve in a lifetime. You have more time than you think. Impatience will lead to overpaying for assets and consumables, and you risk others taking advantage of you. There are great deals out there all the time. If you miss this one, there will be others that come along. They may even be better.
